endings.answer: The word [[Москва]] is in the [[accusative case]] because it follows the preposition [[в]] (in).
The word [[кни́гу]] is in the [[пространственное лицо|objective case]], because it answers the question «about what?».
The word [[вре́мени]] is in the [[глагольное число]] ([[Nominative]]) case because it is the subject of the sentence.
The word [[бра́т]] is in the [[глагольное лицо]] ([[Nominative]]) case because it is the object of the verb [[давать]].
The [[русский]] word [[шко́ло]] is in the [[accusative case]] because it is the direct object of the verb [[идём]].
The word [[ру́чка]] is in the [[глагольное лицо]] ([[Nominative]]) case because it shows the object of the verb «пишет» ([[verb form]]).
The word [[ма́ма]] is in the [[глагольное лицо|subject]] form because the verb [[ви́деть]] (to see) requires the [[глагольное лицо|subject]] agreement.
The word [[бра́та]] is in the [[местоиме́нный падеж|nominative case]] because it is the subject of the sentence.
The word [[стол]] is in the [[глаголный падеж|nominative case]] because it is the subject of the sentence.
The word [[ма́мы]] is in the [[глагольное число]] ([[masculine]]) and follows the preposition [[«в»]], so it takes the [[accusative case]].
The word [[Россия]] is in the [[accusative case]] because it follows the preposition [[о]].
The word [[книг]] is in the [[accusative case|accusative]] because it follows the preposition [[в]].
The word [[стола́]] is in the [[accusative case]] because it is the direct object of the preposition [[на]].
The verb form is [[глагол]] [[глагольное число]] ([[я]]) in the [[глагол совершенного вида]] ([[глагол]]) present tense. The ending matches the subject ([[я]]) and the verb's role in the sentence.
The verb form is [[глагол|verb]] [[глагол|second person singular]], and the ending matches the preposition [[с]] (with).

The verb form is [[глагол|verb]] [[глагол в форме настоящего наклонения|present tense]], and the ending matches the subject [[они|they]], which is in the [[первой лица множественного числа|first person plural]].
The verb form is [[глагол|verb]] [[глагол в прошлом времени|past tense verb]], and the ending matches the subject [[она|she]] in the [[первой личной функции|first personal case]].
The word [[но́вая]] is in the [[глаголный падеж|nominative case]] because it is the subject of the sentence.
The word [[Мне]] is in the [[первой лица|first person]] [[часть предложения|person]] and the sentence is the subject, so it ends in [[Я|me]].
The word «Петербу́рге» is in the [[accusative case]] because it is the direct object of the preposition «в» ([[in]]).
